title: ElectroNeek is the First RPA Platform to Achieve Zapier Partner Program Status

body_markdown:
ElectroNeek, the award-winning RPA platform built exclusively for MSPs, is revolutionizing the automation industry by becoming the first and only RPA provider to achieve Zapier Partner Platform integration status. This unprecedented partnership will allow ElectroNeek customers to access over 5,000 popular business apps for even more automation potential with streamlined workflows.


ElectroNeek's platform enables IT Service Providers to build, sell, and support their RPA-as-a-Service business with its innovative Hub architecture. With the Zapier integration, MSPs can easily connect their ElectroNeek RPA solutions to top apps like Salesforce, Trello, and Gmail - making it simple for them to automate repetitive tasks for their business and improve productivity for their clients.


With this integration, ElectroNeek continues to lead the way in RPA solutions for MSPs, providing the most comprehensive and easy-to-use automation platform on the market. We are excited to see what our customers can accomplish with this new integration and look forward to continued growth and success.
